audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0-4 of the level chart disagreed between layers: content win[0..4]=Azir (matching packet.levelChart, which reads Azir on all seven rows) while full phases[0..4].side all read "Skill". Rows 5-6 disagree the other way: win[5]=win[6]=Azir but phases[5].side=phases[6].side=Kassadin — and the phases whys under those two rows describe AZIR winning, so those rows argue with themselves.
audit.why: For rows 0-4 every source agrees Azir: the packet chart, the content winner, both sets of whys, and the kit (Kassadin has no dash before 6, Null Sphere reaches only 650, Force Pulse needs 400 to land). For rows 5-6 I cannot decide from the kits alone — a 48.06% win rate and Riftwalk reaching 2s at rank 3 argue for Kassadin, the packet chart and both content rows argue for Azir.
audit.corrected: phases[0..4].side -> Azir with all five whys rewritten to match. Rows 5 and 6 LEFT ALONE per the chart rule and raised in questionsForUser.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose treated Kassadin's power curve as item-based ("his mana-sustain item spike", "a scaling item spike"). His curve is rank-based: Riftwalk is 5s at rank 1, 3.5s at rank 2, 2s at rank 3 — levels 6, 11, 16.
audit.why: enemyKit R cd "5/3.5/2" with stacking mana cost on repeats. That is the whole spike schedule, and it is levels, not gold.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes, spikes[2].text, whys[3] and report[9].t now key off levels 6/11/16 and the shrinking Riftwalk cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one interaction was stated; breakdown.cooldowns held no digit at all (packet defect: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere', sequencingCues 0). Two outright factual errors: spikes[0].text and content early both said Kassadin has 'no shield' / 'no defensive tool' early.
audit.why: Null Sphere grants him a magic-absorbing shield on cast from rank 1, and Azir's damage is entirely magic — so the shield eats your poke specifically. Void Stone reduces magic damage taken and ignores unit collision, so minions never body-block his approach and your soldier DPS lands lighter on him than on anyone else. Force Pulse charges from spells cast in his vicinity, meaning your own W and Q spam arms the 400-range cone that slows you. Nether Blade is an auto-attack reset on a 7s cooldown that also restores his mana — the wind-up is the burst tell (missingInteractions: autoreset-burst-tell).
audit.corrected: All four written into breakdown.cooldowns, tradeGood, tradeBad, phases[2].why, phases[3].why, dosFull[0].d, spikes[0].text and content early/mid/late.

audit.why: 48.06% over 360 games; no rank tiers written anywhere.

audit.why: The punishable numbers are Riftwalk 5/3.5/2, Force Pulse 21 down to 17, Null Sphere 9 at rank 1, and your own E at 22.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wave section was the generic Azir template with no reference to why shoving matters against this specific enemy.
audit.why: Kassadin's power is levels, so denied CS and XP directly delays rank 2 and rank 3 Riftwalk. That makes the crash the win condition rather than a tempo tool.
audit.corrected: breakdown.wave and report[4].t rewritten around denying the levels.

audit.why: Void Stone is flat magic damage reduction, so raw AP output matters more here than usual. I deliberately did NOT write Void Staff: Void Staff pierces magic resist, which is not what Void Stone does, and claiming it counters the passive would be wrong.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now names Rabadon's and states the Void Stone reason.

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim under 'Shove crashes and ping his every roam', and dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string verbatim under 'Let him shove-and-roam without pings'. Both replaced with bodies that match their titles.
Nothing recorded about whether Emperor's Divide's wall stops Riftwalk.
audit.why: Riot's text calls Riftwalk a teleport, while the derived flag labels it a dash that 'walls can deny' — the flag and the description disagree, so I refused to assert either way and kept every R line to what is certain: the knockback buys distance and costs him mana to undo. spikes[1].text previously claimed the ult walls him away 'entirely'; that overclaim is removed.
audit.corrected: Claim removed, not replaced with an opposite claim.

edits.before: Avoid all trades until Riftwalk cooldown allows safe poke

notes: CHART, rows 0-4: fixed. full phases[0..4].side was "Skill" while content win[0..4] said Azir and packet.levelChart says Azir; I moved the full layer onto that verdict and rewrote all five whys in the same proposal. No win[N] edit is needed — win[N] already holds the target value. CHART, rows 5-6: LEFT ALONE on purpose. win[5]/win[6] say Azir and packet.levelChart says Azir, but full phases[5].side/phases[6].side say Kassadin while the whys under those same two rows describe Azir winning — the full layer contradicts itself there and I could not resolve it from the kits. Kassadin's Riftwalk reaching 2s at rank 3 and the 48.06% win rate argue Kassadin owns the last two rows; the packet and content argue Azir. That is a pre-existing two-layer disagreement, not one I introduced. See questionsForUser. FACTUAL ERRORS CORRECTED: spikes[0].text and content early both stated Kassadin has no shield / no defensive tool early — Null Sphere shields him from rank 1, and it absorbs MAGIC damage, which is all Azir deals. FLAG MISFIRE: the derived flag on Riftwalk reads 'dash: mobility that grounding and walls can deny', but Riot's own text says 'teleports to a nearby location'. Per the rule I trusted the description and wrote nothing either way about Emperor's Divide stopping it; I also removed spikes[1].text's claim that the ult walls him away 'entirely'. ITEM CAUTION: I did not write Void Staff against Void Stone — Void Staff pierces magic resist and Void Stone is flat magic damage reduction, so it would be a wrong recommendation. Ratings left untouched throughout: on this page the rating column tracks difficulty and carry threat (7/10, 7.5/10 overall), not the row winner, and moving them would contradict breakdown.difficulty.
